name: All's Well That Ends Well
summary: Ruzzgot says the Venture Co. has paid for its part in the deal, and Friz has received her loot. You return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port while Ruzzgot awaits another shipment.

sections.title: Another Shipment
sections.body: A new shipment is on its way to Ruzzgot, and Friz Frazzlespark is waiting at Powderfuse Port. You return to her in the Riverglades after the Venture Co. has suffered its comeuppance and Friz has received her loot. Ruzzgot calls the transaction smooth. Now Southsea Pirates are due to bring him the next shipment.

faq.answer: Friz Frazzlespark is waiting for you at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

faq.q: What happened to the Venture Co.?
faq.answer: Ruzzgot says the Venture Co. got its comeuppance.
Yes. Ruzzgot says Friz gets her loot.
Ruzzgot expects another shipment from the Southsea Pirates.

attribution: In-game quest text: All's Well That Ends Well
